events_claim_valid.name: events_claim_valid
events_claim_valid.value: ("gateway_events"."status" = 'processing' AND "gateway_events"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "gateway_events"."claim_expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("gateway_events"."status" <> 'processing' AND "gateway_events"."claim_token" IS NULL AND "gateway_events"."claim_expires_at" IS NULL)

events_processed_valid.name: events_processed_valid
events_processed_valid.value: ("gateway_events"."status" = 'processed' AND "gateway_events"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "gateway_events"."payment_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("gateway_events"."status" <> 'processed' AND "gateway_events"."processed_at" IS NULL)

events_failure_valid.name: events_failure_valid
events_failure_valid.value: "gateway_events"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'dead') OR "gateway_events"."last_error_code" IS NOT NULL

idempotency_effect_valid.name: idempotency_effect_valid
idempotency_effect_valid.value: ("idempotency_keys"."effect_kind" = 'query' AND "idempotency_keys"."payment_attempt_id" IS NULL AND ("idempotency_keys"."query_id" IS NULL OR "idempotency_keys"."query_id" = "idempotency_keys"."operation_id")) OR ("idempotency_keys"."effect_kind" = 'payment_attempt' AND "idempotency_keys"."query_id" IS NULL AND ("idempotency_keys"."payment_attempt_id" IS NULL OR "idempotency_keys"."payment_attempt_id" = "idempotency_keys"."operation_id"))

idempotency_lifecycle_valid.name: idempotency_lifecycle_valid
idempotency_lifecycle_valid.value: ("idempotency_keys"."status" = 'in_progress' AND "idempotency_keys"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."claim_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."response_status" IS NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."response_body" IS NULL) OR ("idempotency_keys"."status" = 'done' AND "idempotency_keys"."claim_token" IS NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."claim_expires_at" IS NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."response_status" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_keys"."response_status" BETWEEN 200 AND 599 AND "idempotency_keys"."response_body" IS NOT NULL)

idempotency_expiry_valid.name: idempotency_expiry_valid
idempotency_expiry_valid.value: "idempotency_keys"."expires_at" >= "idempotency_keys"."created_at" + INTERVAL '24 hours' AND ("idempotency_keys"."claim_expires_at" IS NULL OR "idempotency_keys"."expires_at" > "idempotency_keys"."claim_expires_at")

idempotency_success_effect.name: idempotency_success_effect
idempotency_success_effect.value: "idempotency_keys"."status" <> 'done' OR "idempotency_keys"."response_status" >= 400 OR ("idempotency_keys"."effect_kind" = 'query' AND "idempotency_keys"."query_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("idempotency_keys"."effect_kind" = 'payment_attempt' AND "idempotency_keys"."payment_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL)

outbox_target_valid.name: outbox_target_valid
outbox_target_valid.value: ("outbox"."kind" = 'query_alert' AND "outbox"."query_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."payment_attempt_id" IS NULL) OR ("outbox"."kind" = 'payment_followup' AND "outbox"."payment_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."query_id" IS NULL)

outbox_claim_valid.name: outbox_claim_valid
outbox_claim_valid.value: ("outbox"."claim_token" IS NULL AND "outbox"."claim_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("outbox"."status" = 'pending' AND "outbox"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."claim_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."attempts" > 0)

outbox_sent_valid.name: outbox_sent_valid
outbox_sent_valid.value: ("outbox"."status" = 'sent' AND "outbox"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."claim_token" IS NULL) OR ("outbox"."status" <> 'sent' AND "outbox"."sent_at" IS NULL)

outbox_replay_complete.name: outbox_replay_complete
outbox_replay_complete.value: ("outbox"."replayed_by_id" IS NULL AND "outbox"."replayed_at" IS NULL) OR ("outbox"."replayed_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."replayed_at" IS NOT NULL)

attempts_settlement_identity.name: attempts_settlement_identity
attempts_settlement_identity.value: "payment_attempts"."status" NOT IN ('authorized', 'captured') OR ("payment_attempts"."gateway_order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."gateway_payment_id" IS NOT NULL)

attempts_fetch_complete.name: attempts_fetch_complete
attempts_fetch_complete.value: ("payment_attempts"."fetched_at" IS NULL AND "payment_attempts"."fetched_status" IS NULL AND "payment_attempts"."fetched_amount_paise" IS NULL AND "payment_attempts"."fetched_currency" IS NULL) OR ("payment_attempts"."fetched_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."fetched_status" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."fetched_amount_paise" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."fetched_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "payment_attempts"."fetched_amount_paise" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND "payment_attempts"."fetched_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')
